# Quickstart: Solution Scaffold Completion, Identity Consolidation & RBAC (SPEC-0005)

**Date**: 2026-08-11 | **Spec**: [SPEC-0005](spec.md) | **Auth API**:
[contracts/auth-api.md](contracts/auth-api.md) | **Secured routes**:
[contracts/secured-write-routes.md](contracts/secured-write-routes.md) | **Web UI**:
[contracts/web-ui.md](contracts/web-ui.md) | **Data model**: [data-model.md](data-model.md)

This guide validates the Phase 0 trust-boundary feature end-to-end. It is a
**run/validation guide** — implementation details live in `tasks.md` (regenerated by
`/speckit.tasks`) and the implementation phase.

## 1. Prerequisites

- SQL Server with the legacy `VisaEntry` database and the migrated target `VisaFusion`
  database (SPEC-0004 delivered schema + identity import).
- .NET 8 SDK; the `VisaFusion.sln` solution builds (`dotnet build`).
- Configuration (connection strings, `Jwt:*` key) via `appsettings.json` / User
  Secrets — no secrets in source (NFR-004); `ProductionSecretsGuard` fails fast in
  Production with dev-only config.
- For the day-gate integration tests: write access to the target `VisaFusion` database
  `security`-table data (a disposable test copy, per the existing integration-test
  convention — tests self-skip when SQL Server is unreachable).

## 2. Setup

```text
dotnet restore
dotnet build VisaFusion.sln
dotnet run --project src/VisaFusion.Migration -- identity   # idempotent re-run (AC-009)
dotnet run --project src/VisaFusion.Web
```

## 3. Validation Scenarios (map to spec TS-001..TS-014)

| Scenario | Command / check | Expected outcome |
|----------|-----------------|------------------|
| TS-001 5-role login | Hermetic functional test: `POST /api/v1/auth/login` for a user of each role (emp case with gate stubbed open) | Each role returns a JWT with the right role claims; `AgentId` claim for agt; `SuperUser` claim for su (AC-001/FR-017) |
| TS-002 No plaintext | Query `AspNetUsers.PasswordHash` in `VisaFusion`; scan logs | All values PBKDF2 hashes; no plaintext anywhere (AC-002/FR-006) |
| TS-003 Agent isolation | Login as agt A; request another agent's id via a manipulated parameter | `403`, not agent B's data (AC-003/FR-007/FR-016) |
| TS-004 RBAC matrix | Hermetic functional test over every §4.3 route + existing representative endpoints | Anonymous → `401`; wrong role → `403`; correct role → `200`/`501` (AC-004/FR-011) |
| TS-005 Registration escalation | `POST /api/v1/public/register` with a privileged role in the payload; registration with a password under 8 characters | Account created as `guest` only; privileged role never assigned; short password rejected (AC-005/FR-012) |
| TS-006 Backdoor params | Requests carrying `udaanappraj123guruadm` / `udaan12345functiondisplaymarquee` | Identical behavior to requests without them (AC-006/FR-015) |
| TS-007 URL rewrite | `curl -I`/browser on `Default.asp`, `authenticate.asp`, `logon.asp`, `regsub*.asp` | 301 to `/`, `/Auth/Login`, `/Auth/Login`, `/Auth/Register`; unknown `.asp` → 404 (AC-007/FR-003) |
| TS-008 Static assets | Request representative files from `forms/`, `css/`, `js/`, `images/`, `fonts/`, `updateimg/` | 200 from the self-hosted wwwroot (AC-008/FR-004) |
| TS-009 Import idempotency | Re-run `identity` migration step | No-op — no duplicate users (AC-009/NFR-007) |
| TS-010 Inactive account | Login with an `active = false` legacy account | Cannot sign in (lockout, AC-010/FR-009) |
| TS-013 Employee day-gate | Integration test seeding the `security` table: no row today / row with closing time set / open row | `403 rsn=O` / `403 rsn=O` / success — `rsn=C` never produced (AC-011/FR-018) |
| TS-014 Change-password | `POST /api/v1/auth/change-password` (valid / wrong current / new≠confirm / under 8 chars) | `204` + stored hash (no lowercase, no plaintext); `400` for the three error cases (AC-012/FR-019) |
| TS-011 SQLi regression | Raw `'` inputs against the rewritten search endpoints | Parameterized — no injection (NFR-003) |
| TS-012 Golden-file parity | Sanitized subset diff of login/authorization behavior | Old vs new behavior matches (where applicable, per migration plan §10) |

## 4. Automated Tests

```bash
dotnet test tests/UnitTests        # policy catalog, claim resolution, URL rewrite, day-gate evaluation
dotnet test tests/FunctionalTests  # hermetic auth/RBAC/backdoor/rewrite/static-asset tests
dotnet test tests/IntegrationTests # identity lockout + day-gate outcomes (self-skip without SQL Server)
```

All tests must pass before the feature is complete (constitution Principle V). The
Phase 0 exit criterion — "App boots; login works for all 5 roles against migrated
(hashed) credentials; backdoor query params confirmed inert" (`complete_migration_plan.md`
§10) — is proven by TS-001, TS-002, and TS-006.

## 5. Security Spot-Checks

- No plaintext password material in logs, responses, or the admin/user-edit surface
  (AC-002).
- Day-gate + change-password follow the documented contracts
  ([auth-api.md](contracts/auth-api.md)); the deferred admin user-management and agent
  password-set routes do NOT exist yet ([secured-write-routes.md](contracts/secured-write-routes.md) §3).
- The legacy `connection.asp` backdoor and its query parameters have no effect (AC-006).
